— write a project file via Save.
16 Megapixel je Bild, 32 Megapixel an ge: 16 megapixels per image, 32 megapixels of held image data, 4096 sprites, 128 MiB input. Export archives up to 192 MiB. Undo: up to 50 steps; the image budget also applies to the history.
64 × 32 ist ein Arbeitsraster. Höhe, Ank: 64 × 32 is a working grid. Check height, anchor and overlap against the original files.
Absolute Kanaldifferenz zum Original: Absolute channel difference to the original
Aktuelle Gruppe mit separaten, benannten: Current group with separate, named layers and saved visibility.
Aktuelle Gruppe, ohne Raster und Nummern: Current group, without grid and numbers. Invisible sprites are not drawn.
Alle Schnitt-Tiles und Positionsdaten. U: All cut tiles and position data. Unassigned image or mask pixels block the export.
Alpha-Umrechnung nur bei einem nachgewie: Convert alpha only when there is a proven need. PNG expects unassociated colour values; the conversion is not a general repair. Mask channels stay unchanged during colour corrections.
Atlas-JSON des Script Extenders; einfach: Script Extender atlas JSON; simple Unity/AssetRipper sprite JSONs for pivot and PPU. Extract rotated, trimmed or mesh-packed atlases into single images externally first.
Atlas-Metadaten gefunden. Als Atlas + JS: Atlas metadata found. Import as atlas + JSON, not as a single series.
Atlas-Overrides / Einzel-Overrides für S: Atlas overrides / single overrides for the SHCDE Script Extender, PNG, ZIP, OpenRaster and CSV. No changes to game archives, no DDS compression, no automatic Workshop publishing.
Das Bild wird in disjunkte Tiles zerlegt: The image is split into disjoint tiles. Hidden original pixels cannot be reconstructed from a flat PNG.
Das Paket wird vorbereitet, nicht instal: The package is prepared, not installed.
Das aktuelle Projekt wird durch syntheti: The current project is replaced by synthetic example data.
Das ist ein Projektarchiv. Über Projekt: This is a project archive. Load it via Project → Open.
Das vorhandene Schnittbild und seine Zuo: The existing cut image and its assignment are replaced. This step can be undone.
Select a file on the left.
Der Pixelvergleich benötigt gleiche Abme: The pixel comparison needs equal dimensions. For geometry comparisons switch between Original / Edited.
Die ursprünglichen PNG-Dateien einschlie: The original PNG files including masks, without re-encoding.
Dieser Browser unterstützt die benötigte: This browser does not support the required local file and compression functions. Open the HTML file in a current Chromium-based desktop browser.
Ein Farbbild und optional dessen _m.png: Select a colour image and optionally its _m.png.
Einzelbilder, Serien oder ZIP-Archive: Single images, series or ZIP archives
Farb-PNGs und zugehörige _m.png gemeinsa: Select colour PNGs together with their _m.png. Atlas import: one colour PNG, one JSON file and optionally a mask of equal size. No GM1 files or Unity archives.
Formale Prüfungen, Hinweise und Projektm: Formal checks, notes and project metadata.
Für das Schnittbild ist keine Farbmaske: No colour mask is loaded for the cut image.
Für den Vergleich fehlen Bild- oder Mask: Image or mask data is missing for the comparison.
Für diesen Sprite ist keine Maske gelade: No mask is loaded for this sprite.
Für maskierte Quellen einzelne Ebenen be: Keep separate layers for masked sources. An overlaid colour mask cannot be flattened shader-neutrally.
Geprüft werden Daten, Zuordnung und Expo: Data, assignment and export rules are checked. Rendering, animation meaning and usage rights cannot be verified automatically.
JavaScript muss für den lokalen Editor a: JavaScript must be enabled for the local editor.
No sprites in the selected scope.
Keine formalen Exportfehler gefunden. Di: No formal export errors found. The check does not replace an in-game test.
Keine passende SHCDE-Zielreferenz gelade: No matching SHCDE target reference loaded. Equal numbers in SHDE and SHCDE do not prove an equal assignment.
Lokale Browser-Sicherung ersetzt keine P: A local browser backup does not replace a project file.
Manuell zuordnen: „Zuordnen“ aktivieren,: Assign manually: activate 'Assign', choose a tile and paint. Unassigned image and mask pixels block the export. A flat image contains no hidden original pixels.
Maskenkanäle werden nicht automatisch er: Mask channels are never generated or reinterpreted automatically. Check the material in game. Atlas overrides are an experimental Script Extender feature.
Nicht alle Quellen besitzen eine Bildnum: Not all sources have an image number.
Additional files that cannot be assigned.
Nummernlücken als freie Rasterplätze erh: Keep number gaps as free grid slots
Ohne Rotation. Breite und Höhe durch vie: Without rotation. Width and height divisible by four. JSON rectangles and pivots use the bottom-left origin.
Originale, Bearbeitungen, Zielreferenzen: Originals, edits, target references and cut data in one project file.
PNG 1/2/4/8 Bit; RGB/RGBA, Graustufen, P: PNG 1/2/4/8 bit; RGB/RGBA, greyscale, palette and Adam7. 16-bit PNG and APNG are explicitly rejected. ZIP: store or deflate.
Matching target reference or mask missing.
Pro Zielgruppe ein Atlas. Quelle→Ziel, P: One atlas per target group. Check source→target, pivot and PPU beforehand.
Quelle und Ziel am Pivot · Pixelmaßstab,: Source and target at the pivot · pixel scale, no shader preview
Rastergrößenänderungen und „Raster anwen: Grid size changes and 'Apply grid' replace the manual assignment. Changes can be undone. Cut areas are stored as an RGB index image.
Rasterplätze einzeln oder über „Plätze z: Edit grid slots individually or via 'Assign slots'.
Rasterplätze: vorne nach hinten, innerha: Grid slots: front to back, within each diagonal left to right. Drawing order and numbering are separate settings.
Rückgängig- und Wiederholen-Schritte wer: Undo and redo steps are deleted. Original images and the current project are kept.
SHDE-Quellen mit SHCDE-Zielreferenzen ab: Match SHDE sources with SHCDE target references. Target names must match the internal GM group exactly. No automatic ID translation between the games.
SHSPRITE archiviert Originale und Bearbe: SHSPRITE archives originals and edits with SHA-256. Old v0.1 JSON projects are imported. Browser backups are local and may be deleted by the browser.
Visible sprites in the selected scope.
Ungespeicherte Änderungen am aktuellen P: Unsaved changes to the current project will be discarded.
Ungespeicherte Änderungen des aktuellen: Unsaved changes of the current project will be replaced.
Ungespeicherte Änderungen werden verworf: Unsaved changes will be discarded. The local backup is no substitute for a saved project file.
Weitere Hinweise stehen im exportierten: Further notes are in the exported check report.
Zuerst ein Gesamtbild für den Schnitt la: Load a full image for cutting first.
Zuerst eine Gruppe mit sichtbaren Sprite: Select a group with visible sprites first.
_m.png wird unverändert mitgeführt. Glei: _m.png is carried along unchanged. Same geometry as the colour image. No automatic generation of team colour or vegetation channels.
